# Tandem

> > Tandem is a global language exchange platform connecting millions of learners across 300+ languages with native speakers, CEFR-aligned certification, and comprehensive cultural learning resources.

Based in Berlin, Tandem offers language learning through conversation practice, online proficiency testing, and certification programs aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR). The platform provides both mobile and web-based experiences for learners studying languages from Korean and Japanese to Portuguese and Russian.

## Key Topics

- Language Exchange
- CEFR Certification
- English Proficiency Testing

## About Tandem

- [About Tandem](https://tandem.net/pages/about-us): Company story & mission of Berlin-based global language exchange community
- [Keeping yourself safe on Tandem](https://tandem.net/pages/psa): Safety guidelines for avoiding scams, sextortion & protecting user privacy
- [What are the safest language learning platforms online?](https://tandem.net/blog/safe-language-learning-apps): Safety comparison of language platforms including Tandem & Duolingo features

## Certification & Testing

- [Ottieni la tua certificazione di inglese online con Tandem](https://tandem.net/it/pages/certificates): Online English certification & CEFR-aligned testing from beginner to advanced
- [Онлайн-тест и сертификат по английскому языку B2 от Tandem](https://tandem.net/ru/pages/certificates/english-language-b2): B2 English proficiency test & CEFR certificate for upper-intermediate level

## Platform Features

- [全新Tandem網頁版](https://tandem.net/zh-hant/pages/tandem-web): New Tandem web version with desktop chat, translation & Apple ID login

## Language Learning Guides

- [70 Common Portuguese Phrases to Jumpstart Your Learning](https://tandem.net/blog/portuguese-phrases): Essential Portuguese phrases for travel, greetings, and everyday conversation
- [What to Know About the Japanese Alphabet](https://tandem.net/blog/japanese-alpabhet): Beginner's guide to Japanese writing systems and alphabet fundamentals
- [Mastering Spanish Numbers 1 to 100](https://tandem.net/blog/numbers-in-Spanish): Learn to spell, pronounce & count Spanish numbers 1-100 and beyond
- [Indirect Object Pronouns in Spanish](https://tandem.net/blog/indirect-object-pronouns-spanish): Spanish grammar guide to indirect object pronouns with practice examples
- [How to Write an Email in Korean](https://tandem.net/blog/how-to-write-an-email-in-korean): Korean email writing tips covering etiquette and formal communication

## Cultural Learning

- [홀리 축제(Holi Festival)에 대해 알아야 할 모든 것](https://tandem.net/ko/blog/the-holi-festival): Guide to India's Holi Festival traditions and cultural significance
- [14 Korean Idioms That Make No Sense in English](https://tandem.net/blog/korean-idioms): 14 Korean idioms with literal translations and real meanings explained
- [꼭 알아야 할 러시아어 속어 24개](https://tandem.net/ko/blog/russian-slang): 24 essential Russian slang words and colloquial expressions for fluency
